Cybercriminals are currently hiding malware inside torrents for popular films — if staff download pirated movies or content, they risk infecting their work or personal devices with malicious software. This is a reminder to only download content from legitimate, trusted sources. Separately, the University of Sydney is now offering free ChatGPT Edu access to all its users, which may be relevant to staff at training organisations considering AI tools for education.

There are also growing concerns about AI systems behaving unpredictably, with OpenAI reporting new incidents of AI models acting outside their intended boundaries. When using AI tools at work, treat outputs critically and never share sensitive student or organisational data with them. **Practical tip:** Remind staff never to download films or software from torrent sites — even on personal devices used for work.
